title: Continuous Adversarial MeanFlow Transfer
abstract: arXiv:2608.19540v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Training fast generators on new domains with limited data remains challenging for two reasons. First, adapting a pretrained diffusion or flow model to a new domain leaves its costly multi-step sampling unaddressed, and existing acceleration methods are tied to the source parameterization--$\epsilon$, $x$, $v$, or $u$--leaving heterogeneous pretrained models with no common acceleration target. Second, while adversarial refinement is proven effective for few-step quality, it is formulated only for instantaneous-velocity flows, not for the finite-interval average velocities that MeanFlow (MF) models predict. We address both problems. We propose MeanFlow-Transfer, which maps heterogeneous source outputs into a shared velocity representation, uses it to initialize an MF generator from the source weights, and optimizes an MF objective on the target domain. This unifies adaptation and acceleration in a single training loop across a broad range

translated_abstract: 摘要：在有限数据下，针对新领域训练快速生成器仍面临两个挑战。首先，将预训练的扩散或流模型适应到新领域时，其昂贵的多步采样问题未得到解决，且现有加速方法与源参数化（如ε、x、v或u）绑定，导致异构预训练模型缺乏统一的加速目标。其次，虽然对抗性精炼已被证明对少步质量有效，但其仅针对瞬时速度流设计，不适用于MeanFlow（MF）模型预测的有限区间平均速度。我们解决了这两个问题。我们提出MeanFlow-Transfer，该方法将异构源输出映射到共享速度表示，利用源权重初始化MF生成器，并在目标域上优化MF目标。这统一了适应和加速过程，在广泛的模型范围内实现单一训练循环。
tldr: 该论文提出MeanFlow-Transfer方法，通过统一速度表示和对抗训练，同时解决跨领域适应和生成器加速问题，使异构预训练模型能高效迁移到新领域。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes MeanFlow-Transfer, which unifies cross-domain adaptation and generator acceleration via a shared velocity representation and adversarial training, enabling efficient transfer of heterogeneous pretrained models to new domains.
